structural_change: NEW master: the closed engine column leaf ot_coll_col_tile with a 64-word FIFO per source (8 x 32x128 macros, 194.4 x 194.4). Why: TP8 board crossing (LAT 339): the engine stops broadcasting once its local-source FIFO holds DEPTH words (can_tx[RANK]); DEPTH 32 -> AR256 1,683 cycles (1.50x the 1,121 price) even with link-level credits; DEPTH 64 + 128-word result queues -> 953 (WT0 sweep). Same control, same pin plan as coll_col_tile_mga (CLOSED TT +237 / FF +4), slot index 6 bits.
